Alaska did not provide parole data for 2017 and all 2017 populations were estimated. For information on specific states, see Probation and Parole in United States, 2017-2018, NCJ 252072 (http://www.bjs.gov/content/pub/pdf/ppus1718.pdf).

Alaska provided information on the total number on community supervision, but was unable to report separately for those on probation. Oregon was unable to provide data for 2015 because of computer system issues. For information on imputing for non-response, see Probation and Parole in United States, 2015, NCJ 250230 (https://www.bjs.gov/content/pub/pdf/ppus15.pdf (last accessed, November, 2016).

Alaska supervises probation and parole in a combined program. The data provider is unable to report probation and parole data separately. The January 1, 2018 and December 31, 2018 parole population counts were imputed based on the December 31, 2017 parole population count. For information on the methods used to impute the parole population for non-reporting agencies and on the methods used to impute entries and exits, see Methodology in Probation and Parole in the United States, 2018 NCJ 250230 http://www.bjs.gov/index.cfm?ty=pbdetail&iid=5784).
